scoringInfo.title: How Leaderboard Scores Work
scoringInfo.description: Your total leaderboard score is calculated using a weighted formula based on your course activity:

weights.quizzesDesc: Points earned from passing quizzes and final exams.
weights.participationDesc: Points earned from forum posts, peer reviews, and active discussions.
weights.completionDesc: Points awarded for completing lessons and modules on time.

scoringInfo.note: Scores are updated automatically. If you tie with another learner, the one who reached the score first is ranked higher.
